deployments_detail.use: Shopify Magic (generative AI for product descriptions, emails, content) and Sidekick conversational commerce assistant embedded across the platform

Sidekick, Shopify's AI commerce assistant in the merchant admin, powered by Anthropic Claude (Sonnet 4.5) running on Google Cloud. Converts natural language into ShopifyQL analytics queries, orchestrates 50+ tools, and helps merchants set up and run stores. In production serving millions of merchants. [Anthropic (Claude Sonnet 4.5), Google Cloud]

Engineering agentic-systems detail on Sidekick's production build: agentic loop, LLM-as-judge evaluation, tool scaling from 0-20 to 50+ tools. Documents Sidekick as a deployed production system with evaluation metrics. [Anthropic (agentic loop)]
deployments_detail.value: LLM judge Cohen's Kappa improved 0.02 to 0.61 (human baseline 0.69); ShopifyQL syntax validation ~93% to ~99%

deployments_detail.use: Semantic Search: AI-powered storefront search in the Search & Discovery app that understands buyer intent beyond keyword matching (e.g. 'something to wear in the summer'). Live to merchants on Shopify and Advanced plans. [none]

Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) / agentic commerce platform: open standard co-developed with Google enabling AI agents to search Shopify's Catalog, build carts and check out. Powers native shopping in Google AI Mode/Gemini and Microsoft Copilot Checkout; supports REST and MCP. [Google (UCP), Microsoft (Copilot Checkout), MCP]

Shopify Magic AI text generation: generates product descriptions, email subject lines, blog posts and headings from merchant inputs using generative AI. Built into the Shopify admin and available to merchants. [none]

Shopify Magic AI media/image generation in the file editor: background replacement, generative background/scene creation from text prompts, and image extension (outpainting) for product photos. Deployed across Basic, Grow, Advanced and Plus plans. [none]

Shopify + OpenAI ChatGPT commerce: Shopify merchants sell directly inside ChatGPT conversations via Instant Checkout / Agentic Commerce Protocol, with products auto-formatted for AI discovery and orders flowing into Shopify admin. Early brands include Glossier, Spanx, Vuori, Away, Stanley 1913, Steve Madden. [OpenAI (ChatGPT, Agentic Commerce Protocol)]

Fraud analysis: machine learning models trained on historical transactions across all Shopify stores flag orders as low/medium/high chargeback risk in the merchant admin. Deployed to stores on Grow plan or higher and Shopify Payments merchants. [none]

Shopify Payments machine learning model that assesses transaction risk across the customer journey to intelligently route high-risk transactions through 3D Secure authentication, boosting payment success and cutting fraud chargebacks. Rolled out to all Shopify Payments merchants. [none]
deployments_detail.value: +26 bps payment success (~$471M additional annual GPV); 20% reduction in fraud chargebacks (~$62M annual merchant savings)

deployments_detail.use: Internal engineering adoption of Anthropic's Claude Code: Shopify engineers use Claude Code across the organization to build internal tools, described by Shopify's Director of Applied AI as transforming how they build internal tools. [Anthropic (Claude Code)]
